text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah— Whew...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early morning. I was doing morning training
with Calstone Light O.
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we wrap it up?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Not done yet—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of Calstone Light O's gaze
was a small Umamusume running along the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...How nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Back when I was in the development club, I was completely absorbed in it too.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Running from sunrise
to sunset—

text_block_list.name: Young Right O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahh!!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Senior
text_block_list.text: That way is dangerous! Come back, Right O-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Young Right O
text_block_list.text: I can do this! I can make it!! Faster, even faster!!

text_block_list.name: Young Right O
text_block_list.text: What an... what an insanely long home stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Young Right O
text_block_list.text: This course was made for meeeeee!!!

text_block_list.name: Training Club Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"That's a runway, you know?!
That is NOT a place you're supposed to be running on—!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, it's a fond memory.
choice_data_list: Y-You were really amazing back in the day.
Y-You were really amazing back then, huh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...And in the past?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: You think I'm different now!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's not allowed!
Let's train! Right now!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll show you just how devoted I am!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's see what you've got!
I never said you weren't giving it your all right now.
I'm not saying you aren't trying your hardest right now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'll show you just how devoted I am!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's see what you've got!
I never said you weren't giving it your all right now.
I'm not saying you aren't trying your hardest right now.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAH--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the promise was made to train in pursuit of speed.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "...Ah! You're right!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. That was thoughtless of me.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, alright.
Let's head back to the dorms."
